notes.title: Update #3 Version S.1.5
notes.notes:
Hey again, the developer has been hard at work making fixes and changes to the latest build of Drayt Empire.
Below are the details.

[h1]Fixes[/h1][list]
    [*]Grammar and spelling fixes - Fixed
    [*]Rock over crate in the beginning of the game - Fixed
    [*]Starting point unable to go to Drayt’s house – Fixed
    [*]Unable to get the treasure chest in Willbridge castle – Fixed
    [*]Mom is at home and keeps asking you to pick apples – Fixed “mom should not be at home”
    [*]No key for the ship in Willbridge town – Fixed
    [*]Women transports you to a different town – Fixed
    [*]Unable to walk into Drayt’s house at the beginning – Fixed
    [*]Natalie appears in 2 places at the cave and at the polluted town – Fixed,
    [*]Fixed Trigger so that you have to go through the caves to get to the polluted town – Fixed
[/list]


[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
    [*]20 Random loot Treasure chests created
    [*]Added Names on Maps so when you enter a town the name shows up so you know which town you are in.
    [*]Control Tutorial 
    [*]Option to go into Full Screen or Window Mode
[/list]


One again, thanks to everyone that has picked up Drayt Empire on Steam. Thank you for all of your feedback, critique and support.

Dan.
ːSuperPugː

notes.title: Update #2 Version S.1.3
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

We're back with another update. With update S.1.3 we've fixed a large amount of issues that users reported, as well as adding completely new features.

[H1]What’s Changed in the build since last Build?[/H1]
[list]
    [*]Walking Through Trees - FIXED
    [*]Entrance points for castle town – FIXED
    [*]Walking through tables and flags in Casino Town – FIXED
    [*]I can't re-enter the casino / play area despite how many tickets/keys I buy. Also, it still says Golden Ticket vs Golden Casino Key.- FIXED
    [*]I get attacked by monsters (a Lamia anyway) inside the ruined city (south of the desert).     [*]Is that part of the game? It's so much stronger than my charas that I can't escape and my damage do nothing. – FIXED
    [*]It's not possible to enter the upper middle buildings in the wild west town (oil field town?) south west of the castle because you can't walk on or through the grass.  – FIXED
    [*]The image for the enemy Slime is still a red-furred horned creature. Should it be? – FIXED
    [*]The Chicken is on SPEED
    [*]Man with Missing wallet in Willbridge Castle – FIXED
    [*]Walk through Fence Willbridge Castle – FIXED
    [*]Unable to rest in the INN @ Market Town - FIXED
    [*]Triger event when guard speaks to you in Willbridge Castle – FIXED
    [*]Updated Sailors message – FIXED
    [*]Walk through cliff - FIXED
    [*]Updated Sailors message – FIXED
    [*]Grammar Fixed for Sailor Willbridge Castle
[/list]

[H1]Added Features[/H1]
[list]
    [*]Added House in Willbridge Town
    [*]Added More NPC Casino Town
    [*]HUD Screen by Pressing D
    [*]Added additional Map @ Market Town
    [*]Random Loot Treasure chests
    [*]Options Menu added


Thanks for the continued support. The developer is working hard to make changes to Drayt with feedback from the Steam community. 

You rock!
Dan. ːSuperPugː
